width.description: world units = px of the terrain artwork (2048 × 1046 today); every position is in this space

layers.description: drawn bottom → top; image paths relative to the CDN root

minZoom.description: shown only from / up to this zoom (e.g. a street-detail layer for the city)

name.description: `{ de, en }`, more languages as keys; missing → the source language (de)

x.description: the place's ground point, world units

toons.description: the toons whose story uses the place (the builder's "used by", the reader's per-toon view)

hidden.description: hidden until it is unlocked (by `unlock`, later by an event) – default: visible from the start

unlock.description: where the story reaches the place (owner 2026-10-01: places unlock over time) – read before the events exist (M3). `null` = deliberately "not unlockable yet" (owner 2026-10-01, the airport): hidden, and that is fine for now.

chapter.description: the chapter the place's card links to

view.description: how the reader's map frames the place when it centres on it (owner 2026-10-10: "pro Location einen Zoom festlegen … als Mittelpunkt die Location selber, gegebenenfalls noch mit einem Offset"; set in the map builder). Without it: the place's point at `PLACE_ZOOM` (`placeView`).

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

size.description: drawn width in screen px at zoom 1 (default 48); the image keeps its ratio

anchor.description: the ground point inside the image, % of its box (default 50 / 90 = bottom centre) – sits on the place's (x, y)

at.description: reading position in the chapter, 0..1 (default 0) – the runtime rule; set from `slice` by the creator

slice.description: the slice that unlocks it: its image path (the slice's identity – slices have no ids; the Figma pipeline keys slices by image too). Edited from both sides (map builder, the chapter editor's slice), `at` follows it (`sliceUnlockPoint`).

PlaceUnlock.description: When a hidden place unlocks by reading progress: a chapter of a toon, from a reading position on (0..1 of the chapter, the reader's chapter checkpoint – 0 = when the chapter is opened, 1 = its end). `scene` = the screenplay scene that introduces the place (the reference for the event that replaces this rule in the editor, M3/M4).

zoom.description: the zoom when the map centres on the place, `MAP_MIN_ZOOM`..`MAP_MAX_ZOOM` (default `PLACE_ZOOM` – owner 2026-10-11: "kleiner geht schon")

offset.description: the view centre's shift from the place's point, world units (default none: the place itself is the centre)

PlaceView.description: A place's own framing on the reader's map (agents/MAP.md §8.4)

waypoints.description: ordered, ≥ 2; a waypoint is a place or a free point

hidden.description: hidden until an event reveals it (default visible)

PlaceWaypoint.description: A place of the map (`location` = the place id; its waypoint id is the place id)

FreeWaypoint.description: A free point on a route (a bridge, a pass); `id` unique within the route
